text: The Boeing Company is a US-listed commercial and defence aerospace prime with a widely held register and no state shareholder; its largest holders are index managers (Vanguard 9.0%, FMR 7.0%, BlackRock 6.8% as at 31 December 2025). Human-rights relevance is the conduct record: two 737 MAX crashes killed 346 people, the type was grounded for 20 months, and the defence arm sells aircraft and munitions into live conflicts. That is a genuine but non-state record, so concern.
